name: Generalist
flavor: The Mesopredator launch pad — a body plan uncommitted to any single role. Everything is available; nothing is optimised. Branch a fresh lineage to explore a different path.

name: Predator
flavor: Commits to the high-power hunting niche: anomalocaridid-grade raptorial arms, ambush geometry, and a reef-edge territory where every prey item is worth the chase.

name: Armored Grazer
flavor: The biomineralization play: fused sclerites, ossified plating, and a territory in the substrate-rich shallows where food is everywhere and the arms race favours whoever shrugs off the most.

name: Filter Feeder
flavor: Tamisiocaris-grade suspension feeding: the open-water metabolism play. Gear up the filter apparatus and the plankton bloom does the work.
